stage1.impression: A clean, readable rear three-quarter of the carton speaker on a warm taupe sweep, placed right of centre for copy space, but the white faces are near-flat slabs of value and the razor-sharp edges and faint contact shadow make it read as an untextured CG model rather than a photographed object. The black I/O plate crushes to a void and the backdrop runs muddy from pinkish bottom-left to dark top-right, so the light describes the form only as a two-tone face split.

blocking_9: The back is the key face: white margins [783,440,805,620] at 212-232 (184.3 today), 15-25 levels of fall-off from under the eave to the amp plate, and its right silhouette at least 50 levels above the backdrop (22 today: 184.1 to 162.5).
The side, as the shadow face, holds 185-210 and stays at least 30 levels above the backdrop at its left edge (backdrop 160.8 at x 600-628).
Key-face white within dE2000 3 of a same-lightness neutral (R-B 25 today on the lit white) and the sweep at #B4AFA7's hue (R-B at most 14; 26 today).
Accent red within dE2000 5 of #C62828 on the back plinth, the roof's back slope and the fin's back (10.9, 8.0 and 9.5 today).

Amp plate not crushed (crush_pct at most 5 and median 15-45 in [800,665,870,715]; 100 % crushed today) and every connector carrying a specular edge (lum_p95 at least 90 in [892,659,960,684]; 20.1 today).
A contact pool at the base, near corner included: floor falloff at most -20 down [772,824,782,900] (-8.8 today, the corner floor reads 159 like open floor).
A continuous specular line on the near 6 mm vertical round (lum_p95 at least 242 in [774,450,784,600]; 228.2 today, a monotonic 4 px blend).

No reflection band over the Nutrition Facts panel: no change of more than 5 levels within 40 px in the margins [783,250,805,620] and [950,250,966,620] other than the key's smooth fall-off (a 12-14 level band edge today at y 340-390).

changes.problem: The key lights the side instead of the back this frame is for, so the white lacquer behind the label, port and amp sits at 184 against 227 on the side and reads warm grey, the back plinth reads maroon and the back's right edge barely clears the backdrop.

evidence.measured: back white margin lum_median 184.3, RGB (191,183,178), dE2000 16.6 vs #FFFFFF; side [650,250,760,695] lum_median 227.2; back plinth [790,755,830,805] RGB (148,21,16), dE2000 10.9 vs #C62828 (side plinth 4.3); right silhouette profile 184.1 to 162.5 (22 levels) against the left silhouette 160.8 to 226.2 (65). Geometry check: back normal at azimuth +35 deg, side at -55 deg; the key at -45 meets the side 10 deg off normal and the back 80 deg off.

changes.expected: The key meets the back 15 deg off its normal and the side 75 deg off: back margins at 215-228, the side falls toward ~165 until c2 lifts it, the back plinth comes within about dE2000 5 of #C62828, the roof's back slope lifts off its flat 52, and the right silhouette step grows to 55-65 levels. The key stays about 40 deg outside the back's mirror direction (azimuth ~73), so there is no glare on the label; its cast shadow moves behind-left of the base.

changes.problem: The fill sits close to the back's mirror direction with specular 0.3, so its reflection lays a 12-14 level band diagonally across the upper back and the Nutrition Facts panel and washes the fin pink; once c1 moves the key, the side needs this lamp to stay clear of the backdrop.

evidence.measured: back right margin profile 200.4, 199.4, 197.5, 183.4, 183.2, 184.1, 183.4, 182.1 (band edge at y~388; at y~340 on the left margin [783,250,805,620], 195.4 to 181.4; 10-90 width 36 px), running through the label; fin back [705,118,890,142] RGB (169,75,76), dE2000 9.5 vs #C62828; the back letters (metal) reflect it at 238-240.

changes.expected: The fill lands 15 deg off the side's normal and outside every mirror direction in frame (the side's is ~-107, its 2 m panel spans -53 to -87): the side settles at 190-205, at least 30 above the ~160 backdrop at its left edge; the band leaves the back (margins flat apart from the key's fall-off); the fin reads red under the key; the back letters turn metal grey against the white, which keeps them legible.

changes.problem: PBR Neutral's toe subtracts up to 0.04 from every channel, so everything below scene ~0.03 goes to black: the amp plate, the connectors and the port's flare, which the brief requires, are invisible, and the accent red's green and blue are crushed.

evidence.measured: plate interior lum_median 1.7, crush_pct 100 (part amp-plate 95.3); connector box [892,659,960,684] lum_p95 20.1; port flare area [846,498,914,580] median 16.1; lit red on the gable (206,20,14) and side plinth (183,33,24) against #C62828 (198,40,40): G/B at 20/14 and 33/24, dE2000 4.5 and 4.3.

changes.expected: Plate at ~20-35 with screws and connector outlines separating from it, connectors ~45-60, flare ring ~40-50; lit red G/B ~32-40 (dE2000 about 3 or less to #C62828). Mid-tones rise ~5-7 levels and there is no shoulder, so c4 must hold the key face under clip.

changes.problem: The key face's peak channel sits at scene 0.90-1.07, above PBR Neutral's 0.76 shoulder, which squeezes a ~20 % top-to-bottom fall-off into 7 levels so the lit white reads as a card; under Standard (c3) the same key would clip the top of the back.

evidence.measured: side profile 231.0, 230.0, 229.0, 228.0, 227.0, 226.0, 224.9, 223.2 (lum_range 7.8); R 242 in the top slice [650,250,760,300] vs 235 in the bottom slice [650,645,760,695], which inverts through the PBR Neutral shoulder to scene 1.07 vs 0.90; back above the label [785,248,830,292] p95 197.4.

changes.expected: The back (key face after c1) at ~232 under the eave, ~222 at mid-height and ~215 above the amp plate: 15-20 levels of fall-off, nothing above 245, the side's share of the key down to ~0.5 W/m2.

changes.problem: The 5600 K key renders against the default white point, so the #FFFFFF body reads cream and the #B4AFA7 paper reads orange-taupe.

evidence.measured: key-lit side RGB (239,225,214), R-B 25, dE2000 9.1 vs #FFFFFF; copy space [0,0,600,900] RGB (167,154,141), R-B 26 against the paper's 13, dE2000 7.0 vs #B4AFA7; the fill-lit back is cooler, R-B 13, so the two faces of one white differ in hue.

changes.expected: Key-lit white neutral (R-B within +/-4), the sweep at the paper's own hue (R-B ~10-14 at its rendered level), the fill-lit side a touch cool.

changes.problem: The rim at 25 deg behind the product throws a ~2.3 m shadow toward the camera that covers all the visible floor in front evenly, so the base has no contact gradient and the near corner hovers.

evidence.measured: floor in front of the near corner, profile 158.4, 160.1, 161.7, 162.7, 164.4, 165.5, 166.5, 167.2 (falloff -8.8); strip [770,824,782,832] 159.4, the same as open floor; under the back base [860,806,880,900] 140.2 rising to 160.1.

changes.expected: The rim's shadow shrinks to a pool ~0.25 m deep: about 80 % of the strip is blocked at the base and 40 % at 0.3 m out, so the floor at the base sits 25-35 levels under the floor at the frame bottom, and the open floor brightens. The rim also puts ~1.3 W/m2 on the roof's back slope, which is flat at 51.7-52.0 now.

changes.problem: The connections are dark parts on a dark plate with no highlight, so the RCA, socket and switch will not separate from the plate even once c3 lifts it.

evidence.measured: connector box lum_median 1.7, lum_p95 20.1, crush_pct 63.3; part amp-connectors median 13.3, amp-switch 18.0; only the gold RCA (78) and the blue LED read.

changes.expected: Specular edges at 150-255 on the connector shells, RCA rim and switch, so each connection reads as its own object at full-frame size; the plate and the white panel are untouched (receivers only).

changes.problem: No edge carries a highlight: the 6 mm near vertical round is a 4 px blend from side to back and the eaves step straight from red to white, so the carton reads as razor-edged CG rather than rounded lacquer.
changes.expected: The strip mirrors in the near round where its normal points at about -13 deg: a continuous 1-2 px line at 245 or brighter from the eave (y~242) down to ~0.33 m (y~600), with under 3 levels of diffuse lift on either face.

out_of_scope.request: Carry the red plinth band around the corner and down to the floor so the white panel edges stop showing (an 8 px white strip at x 770-778 between the two plinth faces and a ~5 px white line along the base).
out_of_scope.why: They read as seams and put a 218-level white edge exactly at the floor contact, which keeps the corner floor at 159 and helps the near corner look as if it hovers; the plinth's construction is fixed geometry.

out_of_scope.request: A satin anodised finish on the amp plate (roughness ~0.35) so it carries a soft reflection instead of reading as a void.
out_of_scope.why: The plate is 95 % at L 3 or below (median 1.7); the Hypex FusionAmp is a real named product whose finish is its own and is not among the card's material presets, so only the view transform and glints are prescribed.

out_of_scope.request: Wider shadow lines under the gable and over the plinth.
out_of_scope.why: At 3 mm they are ~2 px here and do not read (eave profile 51.4, 59.6, 132.7, 199 with no dark line; plinth top 1.7, 155.6, 48.6), so the roof-to-body and body-to-plinth joints carry no definition; they are spec geometry.
